messages:
kate: Quick follow-up from yesterday's outage — we had missing spans in the tracing service and a bad aggregation window in analytics which amplified the impact. Need clear owners + dates for fixes.

owen: I'll take the span-loss bug in the collector. Root cause looked like the new backpressure branch dropping partial traces when the batch size exceeded 128. I can put a fix and test harness together. ETA: EOW next Fri (2026-03-27).

samir: I'll own the aggregation correctness fix. The rolling-window SQL was doing integer division when group_count==0 and silently returned NULLs; also found a downstream dedupe job that re-aggregates incorrectly. Planning a patch + gated rollout. ETA: Tue (2026-03-24) for patch, canary Wed.

lina: I'll investigate the ETL lag/late data pipeline. Early suspicion is the airflow scheduler backoff combined with transient BQ throttling at 02:00 UTC. I'll add stronger visibility and a replay plan. ETA: 3/26 for instrumentation, 3/29 for automated replay job.

ton y: @team please add runbooks. I'll create an incident runbook that ties trace gaps -> aggregation failures -> ETL lag troubleshooting steps. Also will add a rate-of-change alert on span ingestion at 10% drop for 10m.

incidents-bot: Postmortem draft: https://redwoodinternal/docs/postmortems/1773004567 - PR 4587 created for postmortem edits.

kate: Thanks — let's capture action items here so we can track. Small checklist below, comment when you accept.

- owen: collector fix, unit tests, add telemetry (dropped_batches metric) — ETA 2026-03-27
- samir: aggregation SQL fix, add regression tests + canary deploy — ETA 2026-03-24 (canary 03/25)
- lina: schedule/resilience: add instrumentation, implement automated replay for late partitions — ETA 2026-03-26 / 2026-03-29
- tony: runbook + alerting, postmortem PR review — ETA 2026-03-23

owen: accepted. I'll create a small harness that replays synthetic traces and assert no partial drops. Will post link to PR when ready.

samir: accepted. I'll also add a dataset of failing aggregation examples to the eval suite so we don't regress.

lina: accepted. I'll instrument the airflow tasks and add a metric for scheduling delays.

kate: One more ask — recurring pattern detection. This is the third time we see midnight/02:00 UTC spikes in ingestion over the past 90 days. Can we add a weekly digest to the ops channel and check for repeating windows?

ton y: I'll add a cron that posts weekly spike summaries into #eng-sre and link to the incident digest.

kate: ok. For tracking: we'll run a 2-week follow-up meeting on 2026-04-07 to validate rollouts and confirm no regressions. If any owner needs to move ETA, update the postmortem doc and ping here. :white_check_mark:

incidents-bot: Action items updated in tracking board: https://redwoodinternal/boards/incident-tracker/4587 (owners assigned)

owen: quick snippet of the failing condition i captured:
```
# simplified pseudocode
if batch_size > 128 and backpressure == true:
    drop_partial_traces()  # bad branch, loses spans
```

owen: I'll replace drop_partial_traces with a buffered flush and add counter metrics.

samir: SQL diff I'll push to PR: changed `SUM(value)/COUNT(value)` -> `CASE WHEN COUNT(value)=0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(value)/NULLIF(COUNT(value),0) END` and added explicit casts.

lina: For ETL replay plan: will create a backfill job that takes incremental partitions based on event_time; will include a dry-run mode first.

kate: Great. I'll own follow-up meeting and make sure the postmortem gets closure. If any of you run into blockers, ping me directly. :eyes:

tony: thumbs up :+1:
